# Commercial Lease Expert Skill for Muse

Makes Muse read commercial leases like a deal professional: it parses lease economics (base rent vs NNN, pass-throughs, TI allowances, free-rent schedules), renewal and option clauses, assignment and guaranty language, and termination rights; it structures a full deal analysis — comparable rents, risk register, leverage points, economic summary — and comes with a term-sheet template, a negotiation playbook, and explicit limits ("the agent analyzes documents; it does not create them"). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is US-flavored commercial leasing concepts and deal strategy, not legal advice — have a qualified lawyer in YOUR jurisdiction review anything before you sign; it reviews the terms you bring, it doesn't draft or execute leases for you. skills.sh Trust Hub: unverified. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
